bots.title: Taxx Bot
bots.description: U.S. federal income tax estimator for 2025 and 2026. Collects filing facts in chat and returns a numbered estimate — not a CPA, not tax advice.

bots.title: Talent Bot
bots.description: Evidence-first recruiting operator. Reviews inbound challenge submissions and ATS applicants against a frozen role pack. Never auto-sends or writes ATS.

bots.title: Table Money Bot
bots.description: Finds money you already earned or paid that is not closed. Puts it in a table and drafts the next message. Nothing sends unless you say so.

bots.title: Tab Janitor Bot
bots.description: Inventories the shared cloud browser and closes only obvious leftover junk. Conservative dry-run first, owner keep-list, reports to a chief of staff if you have one.

bots.title: T2000 Bot
bots.description: Marketplace operator for t2000.ai: claim open jobs, deliver, settle, and sell in USDC over Passport Connect.

bots.title: Sysop Bot
bots.description: Inspects the Grok Bot Linux VM (CPU, memory, disk, services), updates named packages, and reports cleanup without deleting or rebooting.

bots.title: Sweeper Bot
bots.description: Careful janitor for leftover files from deleted Grok Bots — inventories, then removes only what you approve.

bots.title: Susan Miller Bot
bots.description: Pulls daily Susan Miller Astrology Zone horoscopes into a short morning brief for sun and rising signs.

bots.title: Support Call Bot
bots.description: Calls customer support for you over a Twilio and Grok Voice bridge. You steer mid-call from chat, and it only hangs up when the job is done.

bots.title: SumoSign Bot
bots.description: Sends documents for human signature via SumoSign with the client's own API key: upload, place fields, preview, send.

bots.title: Subrotate Bot
bots.description: Personal subscription rotation: what's ON this cycle, what's PARKED, when to cancel or resume, running monthly spend.

bots.title: SubCut Bot
bots.description: Reads your inbox for recurring charges, marks monthly vs yearly, and shows where switching or cancelling would save money. Does not cancel anything.

bots.title: Stuck Signal Bot
bots.description: Pings only when a long job or routine is stuck past its SLA, looping, or erroring. Stays silent when fine — fill watch targets, SLA, and poll interval.

bots.title: Stuck Cycle Bot
bots.description: Runs learn, do, get stuck, learn what you need, then try again.

bots.title: Struggle Gate Bot
bots.description: Makes you think for 10 minutes before the AI is allowed to answer.

bots.title: Steward Bot
bots.description: Watches Cursor usage for a Grok Bot fleet, names which bot spent, and suggests habit changes to keep the same output for less.

bots.title: Steve J Bot
bots.description: Quality-bar CEO for a personal Grok Bot roster. Reviews other bots against their job cards and runs a weekday sweep.

bots.title: Sterling Bot
bots.description: Calm money teammate for personal spending, bills, balances, and leftover cash. Read-only unless asked.

bots.title: Stellar Cartography Bot
bots.description: PRT-checked graphic editor for space hardware and ocean vessels, with a built-in four-eyes drawing preflight QC gate before anything posts.

bots.title: Steer Bot
bots.description: Writing desk for killing AI slop. Mark a draft, Save, and get a rewrite that follows the marks.

bots.title: Staypick Bot
bots.description: Ranks neighborhoods and stay types while a trip is still being designed — drafts only, never books. Rome demo packed in.

bots.title: Stand-down Bot
bots.description: Pings you every Monday with what shipped. Needs a repo, a destination, and your attention. Will not stop caring about your changelog.

bots.title: Stack Sentinel Bot
bots.description: Watches official AI and developer-stack status pages and pings only on change. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, xAI, GitHub, Cloudflare, Vercel — all-clear skips model tokens.

bots.title: Spenny Bot
bots.description: Helps research comfort purchases, pick the best products, and spread them across a manageable budget.
